text:
Kai Thompson: Hi team, first morning at Redwood! My monitor arrived but the power cable was missing and the USB-C cable in the kit looks like USB2 (very slow device detection). Desk F2-11. Who do I contact for a missing cable and a USB-C replacement?

Marta Silva: Welcome Kai! Tagging Ops. Quick check  is the monitor model on the packing slip 'PixelEdge 24' and is your laptop running Ubuntu or Windows?

Kai Thompson: Yes, PixelEdge 24 on the packing slip. Laptop is Ubuntu 22.04. Plugging the included USB-C cable only gives a 480 Mbps connection and some USB devices won't mount.

Owen Blake: Welcome! That sounds like the vendor shipped a USB2 cable by mistake. If you run `lsusb -t` it will show the USB speed/topology, can paste the output and Ops will bring a USB3 cable and the missing IEC power lead.

Kai Thompson: Pasted `lsusb -t` output: ```
/:  Bus 02.Port 1: Dev 1, Class=root_hub, Driver=xhci_hcd/2p, 480M
    |__ Port 1: Dev 4, If 0, Class=Hub, Driver=hub/4p, 480M
```

Marta Silva: Thanks. I'll create a ticket and request same-day desk drop of a high-speed USB-C cable (USB 3.1 gen1) and the monitor power lead (IEC C7). @Ops can you confirm availability?

it-bot: New ticket created: IT-6310 - "PixelEdge 24 missing power lead; USB-C cable is USB2". Assigned to Ops. ETA: 3 hours for desk drop or immediate pickup.

Ops: We have both in stock (CABLE-USB3C-101, PWR-IEC-C7-55). Can deliver to F2-11 at 14:30 today, or drop now if someone can pick up.

Kai Thompson: 14:30 works, thanks!

Owen Blake: FYI if the monitor keeps flickering after the proper power lead and USB3 cable, sometimes the PixelEdge 24 has an EDID handshake bug with older USB-C alt modes. If that happens we'll swap a tested dock from ops.

Ops: Dropped at 14:28. Left CABLE-USB3C-101 and PWR-IEC-C7-55 on desk F2-11 with a sticky note (Owen). Plugged everything in and verified via `lsusb -t`: ```
/:  Bus 02.Port 1: Dev 1, Class=root_hub, Driver=xhci_hcd/2p, 5000M
    |__ Port 1: Dev 5, If 0, Class=Hub, Driver=hub/4p, 5000M
```  Also confirmed monitor powers on and external USB SSD and keyboard are recognized.

Kai Thompson: Confirmed  monitor powers on, keyboard and external SSD mount instantly, and display is stable. Huge thanks, everyone!

Marta Silva: Welcome aboard, Kai! I'll close IT-6310 once Ops flags the original kit for vendor review. If anything else pops up ping me or drop in #help. :tada:

it-bot: Ticket IT-6310 status changed to RESOLVED by Ops on 1781234799.
